permissions.label: Approval mode
permissions.title: How should AlphaCode act?
permissions.busy: Approval mode can be changed after this task finishes
permissions.unavailable: Approval mode is unavailable until the conversation is ready
permissions.saveFailed: Could not confirm the permission change. Check the current mode and try again.
permissions.help: This setting applies only to this conversation and syncs with the CLI. Ask and Auto allow workspace file tools. Auto only approves predefined routine commands. Full access skips tool approval within the permissions of the AlphaCode process; it does not grant additional system access.

ask.name: Ask for approval
ask.description: Ask before running commands; allow workspace file tools

auto.name: Approve for me
auto.description: Approve routine commands; ask before other commands

full.name: Full access
full.description: Allow all tools and commands with current process permissions
